title: The part after a cut is labelled the way the cut mock labels it
goal: The cut walkthrough mock labels the second half of a cut clip with a number (screen-recording · 2), while the app labels every piece and every half with the plain clip name. Decide which the timeline should show, then make cuts, Lift and Extract all follow it.
notes: Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/video-cut-wt.html line ~298 (#clipB, label "screen-recording · 2") and step text line ~393. App: ClipPiecesBar draws Text(layerName) on every piece (around line 678). Since 2026-10-08 Lift keeps the clip name on both halves (lifting-a-stretch-keeps-both-halves-as-pieces-of), so the difference is now the same for Command K and Lift. Premiere labels both halves with the plain clip name.
acceptance: The user has picked how the part after a cut is labelled on the timeline
Command K, Lift, Extract and Delete on a picked piece all label the part after the cut that way
A walk at Next defaults reads the labels after a Command K and after a Lift
